Implemented archive/unarchive functionality for items. Here's what was done:

**Model Changes** (`backend/app/models.py`):
- Added `archived: bool = Field(default=False)` to the Item database model
- Updated ItemPublic schema to include the `archived` field in API responses

**Database Migration** (`backend/app/alembic/versions/a1b2c3d4e5f6_add_archived_to_item.py`):
- Created migration to add `archived` column to the item table with default value of `False`
- Migration was run successfully

**API Endpoints** (`backend/app/api/routes/items.py`):
- **PUT `/items/{id}/archive`** — Archives an item (sets `archived=True`), respects ownership/permissions
- **PUT `/items/{id}/unarchive`** — Unarchives an item (sets `archived=False`), respects ownership/permissions
- Updated **GET `/items/`** — Now filters to exclude archived items from the default listing for both superusers and regular users

**Tests** (`backend/tests/api/routes/test_items.py`):
- `test_archive_item` — Archives item successfully
- `test_archive_item_not_found` — Returns 404 for non-existent items
- `test_archive_item_not_enough_permissions` — Enforces permission check
- `test_unarchive_item` — Unarchives item successfully
- `test_unarchive_item_not_found` — Returns 404 for non-existent items
- `test_archived_items_not_in_list` — Verifies archived items excluded from default list
